name: Theory of Concrete Structures
description: Introduction-historical developments, material properties, basic design concepts; behavior and design in flexure; behavior and design for shear and torsion; behavior and design for bond; behavior and design of slabs; serviceability limits state- deflection and cracking; behavior and design of compression members – columns and walls; analysis for design moments in continuous systems; good detailing and construction practices; selected special topics.
